name: text-quality
description: Pre-publication draft gate triage for Russian- and English-language text: pass, borderline or fail verdicts on caller-supplied AI-detector and uniqueness signals plus per-span rework guidance.
when_to_use: Use to triage a draft against a caller-supplied detector payload (vendor ai_score readings, flagged_spans, uniqueness_percent, gate thresholds) and to get concrete rework instructions for flagged spans in RU or EN drafts.
